page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The configuration includes a baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps and offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, requiring external network-attached storage volumes for persistent data retention. Hardware acceleration via GPUs is absent on this instance model. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio prioritizes raw compute performance over large memory allocations. This configuration offers a cost-efficient resource profile for execution-heavy workloads that do not demand extensive memory overhead or local storage drives.

Given its dedicated 48-core configuration, 2.7 GHz Intel processor hardware, and 25 Gbps baseline network capability, Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.12xlarge is structured for processing-heavy applications. Primary workload fits include batch data processing, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, application build servers, high-concurrency web serving, and media encoding tasks.
